messages:
Maya: Hi team, just sat down for my first day. M2 Pro Mac, trying to enroll in Kandji and FileVault escrow but hitting a 403 on the profile install. YubiKey 5C not recognized during escrow prompt. Also need Rosetta + GlobalProtect. Any pointers for temp admin or quick fixes? @IT Oncall
Jon: welcome! ping it-oncall. common root cause is ABM/DEP not assigning the device. share serial and a screenshot if you can.
IT Oncall: Hey Maya 44b Can you DM the serial and paste the exact Kandji UI error? If you can run the agent debug that helps: ```sudo /usr/local/bin/kandji-agent enroll --debug```
Maya: Serial: C02Z9V8R2H3K. UI shows "403 Forbidden: device not assigned to org". Debug: "EnrollRequest failed: 403 - device missing from ABM"
IT Oncall: Thanks. I'm checking ABM now. Meanwhile if you need local installs we can open a short Okta elevation for temp-admin. Also try plugging into wired ethernet and re-attempt enroll.
Alex: I reassigned C02Z9V8R2H3K in ABM and re-applied the 'mac-dev-kit' blueprint. Kicking Kandji sync now. Opening a 90min temp-admin Okta approval for Maya (check DMs).
Kandji Bot: Applied policy: mac-dev-kit to device C02Z9V8R2H3K (reconcile by Alex).
IT Oncall: Once you accept Okta elevation, retry the enroll flow or run the debug command. For FileVault escrow: we push the key after successful enrollment. If YubiKey doesn't show up, run yubikey-manager while the escrow dialog is open.
Maya: Accepted Okta elevation. Reran enroll UI 0a Success - Kandji now shows 'Enrolled'. FileVault escrow completed after running `ykman list` and then the escrow UI detected the token.
Maya: Rosetta installed with: `/usr/sbin/softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license`. GlobalProtect got pushed and I accepted permissions. All good now.
Priya: Welcome aboard, Maya :tada: If you need VPN groups or repo access ping me.
Jon: Pro tip: if you hit 403 during Kandji enrollment check ABM assignment first, then request a short Okta temp-admin if you need to install local stuff. YubiKey hardware sometimes needs yubikey-manager running during escrow.
Maya: Leaving notes here so future new hires can search: ABM assignment -> Kandji enroll -> FileVault escrow (run ykman) -> Rosetta -> GlobalProtect. Thanks everyone!
